gap_classification.notes: Bank's own site is accbank.co.in (registry hint 'prokerala.com' was a directory). Homepage loads (HTTP 200) but the 'Interest Rates' nav link is a placeholder (#) and the page shows only loan/financing schemes (Kisan Credit Card, Crop Loan, Farm Mechanization). All candidate rate paths (/interest-rates/, /deposit-rates/, /fixed-deposit/, /deposits/, /rates/) return HTTP 403, and no rate page is search-indexed. Agricultural-financing-focused central co-op; publishes no FD rate page online.
